## Notes and corrections to the table above

- **Volusia (0%) is a key-format artifact, not missing data.** Volusia's v2 `parcel_id` is the county ALT_KEY (7-digit), while NAL `PARCEL_ID` is the 12-digit state parcel number. Joining v2.match_key to NAL `ALT_KEY` instead matches **308,668 of 312,278 (98.8%)**. ALT_KEY rescues nothing meaningful elsewhere (Leon 71, Palm Beach 18, Orange 2, Pasco 1). Phase 3 needs a Volusia-specific join (NAL.ALT_KEY -> v2.match_key) or an extra `alt_match_key` on staging.
- With Volusia corrected: NAL rows 11,112,124, matched about 10,831,991 (**97.5%**). Excluding Volusia: matched 10,523,323 of 10,799,846 NAL rows, NAL-only 276,523 (2.6%), v2-only 102,962 (1.0%).
- NAL-only rows are mostly parcels created after the 2025 roll that v2's geometry was built from (sample IDs are sequential new lots). They have no geometry in v2; they need the 2026 DOR parcel shapefiles, not just the NAL.
- v2-only rows are parcels retired or renumbered since 2025 (or non-parcel features, e.g. Calhoun "Road").
- "Land sqft>0" is low for condo-heavy counties (Miami-Dade, Broward, Pinellas, Palm Beach) because condo units carry no land units in NAL.
- Source-side fill gaps worth knowing before an attribute reload: Charlotte mail address 4.2%, Santa Rosa mail 33.6%, and situs address below 70% in Hamilton, Holmes, Levy, Liberty, Putnam, Suwannee, Taylor.
- Preliminary roll counties (DeSoto, Flagler, Liberty) lack EXMPT_47/48 columns; they load as NULL.
- Statewide fill across matched rows: owner 100%, mail 97.2%, situs 96.6%, JV 98.9%, use code 100%, any exemption 51.9%, sale price 13.6%, sale yr+mo 14.4% (NAL carries only the last two sales).
